name: build-reality-composer-pro-3
description: Author, inspect, and troubleshoot Reality Composer Pro 3 projects, Shader Graphs, Script Graphs, Animation Graphs, and USD asset pipelines.

interface.shortDescription: Author and debug RCP3 projects, graphs, packages, and USD asset pipelines
interface.longDescription: Reality Composer Pro 3 authoring support for Shader Graph materials, Script Graph behavior, Animation Graph state machines, direct package inspection, USD ASCII edits, USD command-line validation, and safe handoff into RealityKit or visionOS apps. Use alongside Build with RealityKit for runtime Swift integration, Profile & Optimize RealityKit for runtime cost evidence, and Build visionOS 27 apps for app build, simulator, ARKit, and distribution workflows.
defaultPrompt: Author or inspect a Reality Composer Pro 3 Shader Graph, Script Graph, or Animation Graph.
Repair a narrow RCP3 package or USD asset issue while preserving authored structure.
Route runtime implementation, profiling, or visionOS app integration to the matching plugin when needed.
